response.body:
This audit selects a small scientific control layer, standard Python research tooling, and conditional LEAN integration for simulation and future IBKR/Alpaca execution. TradingAgents, RD-Agent(Q), FinRL/FinRL-X, Qlib, NautilusTrader and other alternatives receive source-grounded adoption or benchmark decisions.

The PR is now rebased cleanly onto the current scientific branch after merged PR #8. Its diff contains only the long-term build-vs-adopt audit and verification/source packet.

Only audit documentation, decisions and reproducibility evidence are added. Scientific registrations, Amendment 005, FMBH UNRESOLVED, candidate ordering, broker flags, existing code and workflows remain unchanged. No framework migration, alpha experiment, paid provider call, data purchase or trading occurred.

Validation reported by the audit: 240 existing tests passed locally; hosted CI should be treated as authoritative after this rebased head reruns.

Issue: #9
